name: Iron Frame bar Chair Dining Garden Chair with Armrest
material: steel frame w/t electrophoresis + powder coated
description: The Sunburst metal chair with armrest is a particularly light outdoor seating solution. With a weight less than 5 kg, the chair can be flexibly moved, carried and used. The chair with armrests is made of powder-coated iron and is available in various colours. This way the chair blends in well with different environments.
